name: Kaguya
source:
A Jirai-Kei Rock singer and songwriter who rose to fame overnight from a video sharing site. She finds herself in a slump, unable to write songs, when [url=https://vndb.org/c139556]Karuta[/url] comes to pick her. 

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/05/28/karuta/]official site[/url]]
